name: Worldpay Statements API
description:
Retrieve your account statement and see individual entries for all credits and debits. Specify a date range and other optional filter values. Authentication header Authorization: {yourcredentials} Replace {yourcredentials} with your base64-encoded Basic Auth username and password given to you by your Worldpay Implementation Manager.

You must use the Authorization header for any request you send to our Statements API.
